label: DoorDash Ads
terms_note: Ads API Key issued to the advertiser (Ads Manager / CPG advertiser guide); Sponsored Products + Sponsored Brand campaign types; some report breakdowns restricted to Diamond & Gold tier advertisers. Rate limits: not stated on the Redoc page. Free.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (DoorDash Ads API 1.0.29) Confidence: **high** — official Redoc read.
auth: 1. Advertiser account in DoorDash Ads Manager (CPG advertiser guide); request an **Ads API Key**.
2. Send the key per 'Ads API Key Authentication' (header — TODO(verify) name).
3. Create campaign → ad group (targeting + bid) → product ads / creatives → reports.

endpoints.notes: campaignId, bid, targeting{dayparting, merchants, behavioral, interests, keywords}

endpoints.purpose: reports (CATEGORY_SHARE with RETAILER breakdown for Diamond & Gold tiers)

reference.limits: - Rate limits not stated; API key by advertiser onboarding; tier-gated report breakdowns; free.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: DoorDash Ads API key; the Ads API reference's security scheme 'Ads API Key Authentication' reads: 'We will be using stateful token based API keys to authenticate clients, passed in the Authorization header as Bearer {API_KEY}' (https://developer.doordash.com/en-US/redocusaurus/plugin-redoc-11.yaml). Issued to onboarded DoorDash Ads (CPG) advertisers and partners.

config_fields.name: campaign_type
config_fields.help: Campaign type path segment of every campaign call: 'sp' (Sponsored Products) or 'sb' (Sponsored Brand).

adapter.terms: DoorDash Ads API 1.0.29 (https://developer.doordash.com/en-US/api/ads/, OpenAPI at https://developer.doordash.com/en-US/redocusaurus/plugin-redoc-11.yaml): server https://openapi.doordash.com, campaign management under /ads/api/v1/{campaignType}/campaigns and asynchronous reports under /ads/api/v1/sp/reports. Budgets are written in cents (BudgetWrite.daily.unitAmount: 'Integer representing a monetary value in cents').

me.note: No account endpoint is documented; the probe lists one campaign (GET /ads/api/v1/{campaignType}/campaigns?count=1), which verifies the API key.

list_campaigns.note: GET /ads/api/v1/{campaignType}/campaigns?startIndex&count (0-indexed offset). Each CampaignResponse has campaignId, name, status, statusDescription, budget {daily, lifetime: {unitAmount (cents), currency, displayString, decimalPlaces}, pacingStrategy}, startDate/endDate ('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'). The budget stays in raw.budget because it is in cents. account_id and status are not sent (the API key selects the advertiser; no status filter is documented).

update_budget.note: PUT /ads/api/v1/{campaignType}/campaigns {campaignId, budget: {daily: {unitAmount}}} with daily_budget converted to cents; a partial update (the existing pacingStrategy is preserved). This spends money. currency is ignored (the advertiser's currency applies).

pause_resume.note: PUT /ads/api/v1/{campaignType}/campaigns {campaignId, status: ACTIVE|PAUSED} (StatusWrite enum ACTIVE, PAUSED, ENDED). Resuming restarts spend.

not_offered.list_accounts: No account-listing operation exists in the Ads API (tags: Campaigns, Ad Groups, Product Ads, Assets, Creatives (SB), Merchants (Retailers), Keywords (SP), Resources, Catalog, Report, Menu, Targeting; https://developer.doordash.com/en-US/api/ads/); the API key is scoped to the advertiser.
not_offered.get_report: Reports are asynchronous files: 'Create report' (POST /ads/api/v1/sp/reports/{recordType}/create) returns only a reportId, and 'Download report' (GET /ads/api/v1/sp/reports/download/{reportId}) returns a status and a download url to an S3 file (https://developer.doordash.com/en-US/api/ads/#tag/Report), not metric rows.
